items.title: MSD and Isomorphic join forces to develop oncology drugs
items.summary: MSD inks this deal as it looks to offset the looming impact of Keytruda’s patent expiry and secure its long-term growth prospects.

items.title: AI and the digitalisation of pharma manufacturing
items.summary: Executives from Thermo Fisher, Fujifilm and Recipharm outline CDMOs’ uses of, and considerations for, artificial intelligence.

items.title: Novartis CEO leans on surge of pipeline readouts to quell growth fears
items.summary: Novartis has earmarked pipeline assets with multi-billion-dollar sale peaks as it tackles a wave of patent expirations.

items.title: Sanofi rumoured to be eyeing high-profile Insmed takeover
items.summary: Insmed’s shares spiked 20% following these rumours, while Sanofi’s stock dropped 2%, despite analysts backing the potential deal rationale.
